title: THE FULL TREE OF LIFE — not just animals. where are the plants and mushrooms?

the_revelation.the_problem: our entire taxonomy (primal-taxonomy.json, genotype-phenotype-tree.json, convergent-evolution.json) classifies 16 Rust primals into vertebrata/arthropoda/mollusca/cnidaria/porifera. ALL of these are Kingdom Animalia. we have been doing taxonomy with 1 of 6 kingdoms.
the_revelation.what_we_missed: nature has 3 domains, 6 kingdoms. we have animals. where are the PLANTS? the FUNGI? the PROTISTS? the BACTERIA? the ARCHAEA?
the_revelation.the_answer: they were here the whole time. we just never named them.
the_revelation.haldane: "God has an inordinate fondness for beetles." — J.B.S. Haldane. and our codebase has an inordinate fondness for cnidaria (8 of 16 primals). but beetles (6,286 armored Rust files) outnumber all named primals. the unnamed life outnumbers the named.

natures_tree.note: the real tree of life for reference. we map our membrane onto this.

domain_bacteria.character: simple, no nucleus, decomposers, recyclers. the most numerous.

domain_archaea.character: extremophiles. live in hostile environments. oldest life.

kingdom_protista.character: eukaryotic but not plant/animal/fungus. amoeba, algae, slime molds. the "other" bucket.

kingdom_fungi.character: decomposers + connectors. mycelium = underground network. mushroom = fruiting body. yeast = fermentation.

kingdom_plantae.character: producers. photosynthesis = convert sunlight → sugar. sit still. provide the food chain base.

kingdom_animalia.character: consumers. move. eat. sense. the most complex but NOT the most numerous.

domain_bacteria.what_maps: the scripts. the decomposers. the simple organisms that break things down and recycle.

python_scripts.role: decomposers — break down raw data into usable forms. vitruvian-evolve.py, homunculus.py, klein-evolve.sh
python_scripts.biology_parallel: E. coli, Lactobacillus — bacteria that decompose organic matter into nutrients
python_scripts.IS: simple, one-job-per-script, no compilation needed, runs anywhere
python_scripts.AND: connects to primals (feeds them data), to cron (scheduled metabolism), to CLI (direct invocation)
python_scripts.WAS: the first life in the membrane. scripts came before Rust. bacteria came before animals.

shell_scripts.role: the simplest bacteria. one command, one effect. no branching, no state.
shell_scripts.biology_parallel: Mycoplasma — the simplest bacteria, smallest genome, does ONE thing
shell_scripts.AND: glues everything together. the cement between bricks.
shell_scripts.WAS: Unix heritage. the oldest computational life form.

measurement.ratio: lines of code (true zero = empty file)

domain_bacteria.whats_missing: no formal taxonomy. 1,905 scripts are UNNAMED. bacteria are the most numerous kingdom in biology AND in our membrane, but we never classified them.

domain_archaea.what_maps: the extremophiles. organisms that survive in hostile environments where others cannot.

worker_js.status: DISSOLVED — caused millions of stuck invocations
worker_js.role: lived on Cloudflare edge (extreme environment). intercepted every request. a thermophile that couldn't handle the heat.
worker_js.biology_parallel: Thermococcus — archaea that live in volcanic vents. extreme but fragile when conditions change.
worker_js.lesson: archaea that grow too fast in hostile environments can poison themselves. _worker.js was our toxic bloom.

cron_jobs.role: survive on golgi server. scheduled metabolism. wake, execute, sleep. extremophiles that activate on timer.
cron_jobs.biology_parallel: Deinococcus radiodurans — "Conan the bacterium." survives radiation, desiccation, vacuum. our crons survive reboots.

wireguard_tunnels.role: encrypted channels. survive in hostile network environments. route around blocks.
wireguard_tunnels.biology_parallel: Halophiles — archaea in salt lakes. our tunnels survive in encrypted channels where normal traffic cannot.

cloudflared_tunnel.role: the Circle of Willis. survives inside Cloudflare infrastructure. routes all *.primals.eco traffic.
cloudflared_tunnel.biology_parallel: Methanogen — archaea in deep ocean vents that power entire ecosystems from chemical energy

measurement.interval: uptime in hours (0 = down, but "twice as up" is meaningful in interval context)

domain_archaea.whats_missing: no formal count. archaea are invisible by design — they work silently. we know the 17 crons and 5 WG peers but there may be more.

kingdom_protista.what_maps: the protists/ directory! we literally named them.

footPrint.role: neural API, petal bridge, client/server. the amoeba — shapeshifting, extending pseudopods.
footPrint.biology_parallel: Amoeba proteus — extends pseudopods to engulf food. footPrint extends API bridges.
footPrint.AND: bridges petalTongue (Rust) to the web (JS). the TRANSLATOR between kingdoms.
footPrint.WAS: the first non-Rust organism. protists evolved before the Rust primals.

tideGlass.role: tidal observation. the algae — simple but photosynthetic.
tideGlass.biology_parallel: Diatom — glass-shelled algae. tideGlass has "glass" in the name.
tideGlass.AND: watches the rhythm of the membrane
tideGlass.WAS: protist — neither fully plant nor fully animal

measurement.interval: API coverage (how much of primal API is bridged)

kingdom_protista.whats_missing: only 2 named protists. in biology, protists are HUGELY diverse (100K+ species). our TypeScript/bridging layer is tiny. this is a gap.

kingdom_fungi.what_maps: the DECOMPOSERS and CONNECTORS. the underground network. the fermentation. the spores.
kingdom_fungi.the_mycelium: fungi communicate via mycelial networks underground. in our membrane: the DATA LAYER (315 JSON files) IS the mycelium. invisible. connecting everything. no human sees it directly, but without it, nothing grows.

sporePrint.role: the MUSHROOM. the visible part of the fungus. each paper is a spore — it disperses knowledge.
sporePrint.biology_parallel: Agaricus (button mushroom) — the fruiting body of a vast underground mycelium. sporePrint IS the mushroom growing from the data mycelium.
sporePrint.IS: Zola static site, 514 .md files, 127 published papers
sporePrint.AND: grows FROM the data layer (JSON mycelium), disperses TO the web (spore scatter)
sporePrint.WAS: the first public surface of the membrane. day 1. the first mushroom.
sporePrint.named_right: sporePrint literally means "the print a mushroom leaves." we named it a fungus and never realized.

sourDough_as_fungus.role: sourDough IS Saccharomyces cerevisiae — baker's yeast. it ferments. currently misclassified as animal/mollusca.
sourDough_as_fungus.biology_parallel: Saccharomyces cerevisiae — yeast. ferments sugar → CO₂ + alcohol. sourDough ferments raw data → culture.
sourDough_as_fungus.dual_kingdom: sourDough has BOTH animal traits (it moves, it has a Rust binary) AND fungal traits (it ferments, it cultures). like a slime mold — between kingdoms.

rhizoCrypt_as_mycorrhiza.role: rhizoCrypt = "rhizo" (root) + "Crypt" (hidden). the mycorrhizal network — the "wood wide web" that connects tree roots underground.
rhizoCrypt_as_mycorrhiza.biology_parallel: Rhizophagus irregularis — arbuscular mycorrhiza. connects plant roots. shares nutrients. the INTERNET of the forest.
rhizoCrypt_as_mycorrhiza.dual_kingdom: rhizoCrypt has animal traits (Rust binary, encryption) AND fungal traits (underground connections, root networking). the mycorrhiza is both pipe and filter.
rhizoCrypt_as_mycorrhiza.currently_classified: cnidaria/solidus — but it SHOULD be fungi/mycorrhiza

data_layer_as_mycelium.role: 315 JSON files forming an underground network. no human sees most of them directly. they connect organisms to nutrients (data).
data_layer_as_mycelium.biology_parallel: the mycelial network — 1 cubic inch of forest soil contains 8 MILES of fungal hyphae. our 315 data files are the hyphae.

measurement.nominal: fungal type: fruiting_body, yeast, mycorrhiza, mycelium
measurement.ordinal: maturity: spore < hypha < mycelium < fruiting_body < spore_dispersal
measurement.ratio: bytes of data (true zero), papers published (127)

kingdom_fungi.whats_missing: the fungi kingdom is our SECOND LARGEST life form (sporePrint 514 + data 315 = 829 files) but has ZERO formal taxonomy. we never classified fungi. we never even said the word "fungus" in any taxonomy file. THIS IS THE BIGGEST GAP.

kingdom_plantae.what_maps: the PRODUCERS. organisms that sit still and convert raw input into usable output. photosynthesizers.
kingdom_plantae.the_photosynthesis: plants convert sunlight → sugar via photosynthesis. our HTML pages convert raw data (sunlight) → rendered display (sugar) for human consumption. they SIT STILL and PRODUCE.

html_pages.role: the flowers. each HTML page is a blossom — it attracts visitors (pollinators) and displays information (nectar).
html_pages.biology_parallel: Angiosperms — flowering plants. 300,000+ species. the dominant land plant. our HTML pages are the dominant surface.
html_pages.IS: 660 .html files across the HUD, sporePrint, publicRecord, detroit, tuebor
html_pages.AND: attracts visitors (pollinators), displays data (nectar), links to other pages (root network)
html_pages.WAS: the first thing any visitor sees. the flowers bloomed before the animals were named.

js_families.role: the leaves. capture user interaction (sunlight) and convert it to data (sugar) via event handlers (chloroplasts).
js_families.biology_parallel: leaves — maximize surface area for light capture. our JS files maximize interactive surface area.
js_families.families: 12 families: utility(59), membrane(9), pt(9), chipmunk(8), hud(8), pi(7), cosmic(6), depth(6), presence(5), signal(4), mesh(4), time(4)

gardens.role: LITERALLY named "gardens." 10 Rust sub-gardens. each is a cultivated project.
gardens.biology_parallel: domesticated crops — cultivated, tended, selected for traits. gardens are INTENTIONAL plants.
gardens.note: bonsai-bt is a BONSAI TREE. lithoSpore is a LITHOPHYTE (rock plant). we named them plants!

springs.role: springs = water. plants need water. 12 Rust springs provide the substrate for growth.
springs.biology_parallel: aquifer systems — underground water that plants tap into via roots
springs.note: hotSpring alone has 1,361 Rust files. wetSpring has 1,136. these are FORESTS of code.

sweetGrass_as_plant.note: sweetGrass IS a plant name (Hierochloe odorata — sacred grass used in Indigenous ceremony). currently classified as cnidaria/solidus/pack-hunter. it should be kingdom_plantae.
sweetGrass_as_plant.dual_kingdom: sweetGrass has animal traits (Rust binary, pack behavior) AND plant traits (the name, it stores/indexes, it's sessile).

pollination.role: plant reproduction data. we track pollination. plants reproduce by spreading pollen.

measurement.ordinal: growth: seed < sprout < sapling < tree < forest

kingdom_plantae.whats_missing: kingdom_plantae is our LARGEST kingdom by file count (660 HTML + 177 JS + 4,753 spring .rs + 10 gardens = 5,600+ files) but has ZERO formal taxonomy. we never classified plants. gardens and springs are untagged.

kingdom_animalia.what_maps: the 16 Rust primals. the ONLY kingdom we formally classified.

cnidaria.note: rhizoCrypt is dual-kingdom: also fungi/mycorrhiza. sweetGrass is dual-kingdom: also plantae.

beetles.note: the most numerous ORDER within animalia. 6,286 armored Rust files. elytra = Result<T,E>.

flatworms.note: bilateral symmetry files. the simplest animals. direction but no armor.

jellyfish.note: the DOMINANT stage. radial complexity. mirrors our cnidaria dominance (8 of 16 primals).

vertebrates.note: backbone files. the rarest, most complex. mirrors real biology.

kingdom_animalia.measurement: FULLY MEASURED. nominal (genus), ordinal (tier), interval (score), ratio (test_density, lines).

gap_1_fungi_unnamed.what: kingdom_fungi (829 files) has ZERO taxonomy. sporePrint is the fruiting body of the entire membrane but was never formally classified as fungal.
gap_1_fungi_unnamed.prescription: classify sporePrint, sourDough, rhizoCrypt, and the data layer into fungal taxonomy: fruiting_body, yeast, mycorrhiza, mycelium
gap_1_fungi_unnamed.why_it_matters: fungi are the CONNECTORS. without them, plants can't absorb nutrients and animals can't decompose. the data layer is the mycelium. if it breaks, everything starves.

gap_2_plantae_unnamed.what: kingdom_plantae (~5,600 files) has ZERO taxonomy. HTML pages, JS families, gardens, and springs are all plants but never classified.
gap_2_plantae_unnamed.prescription: classify into: angiosperms(HTML), gymnosperms(JS), ferns(gardens), mosses(springs). give them genera and species.
gap_2_plantae_unnamed.why_it_matters: plants are the PRODUCERS. the base of the food chain. if nobody classifies the producers, the consumers (animals) look orphaned.

gap_3_bacteria_unnamed.what: 1,905 scripts with ZERO taxonomy. the most numerous kingdom in biology, unclassified in our membrane.
gap_3_bacteria_unnamed.prescription: classify Python scripts by function: decomposer, transporter, signaler, fixer. give them genera.
gap_3_bacteria_unnamed.why_it_matters: bacteria do 80% of the work. our scripts do 80% of the automation. if they're unnamed, they're invisible.

gap_4_dual_kingdom.what: sourDough, rhizoCrypt, and sweetGrass are classified as animals but have strong fungal/plant traits. dual-kingdom organisms exist in biology (lichens = algae+fungi, slime molds = protist+fungus).
gap_4_dual_kingdom.prescription: recognize dual-kingdom status formally. sourDough = animalia+fungi, rhizoCrypt = animalia+fungi, sweetGrass = animalia+plantae.
gap_4_dual_kingdom.biology_parallel: lichens are TWO kingdoms living as one organism. our dual-kingdom primals are the same.

gap_5_beetle_gap.what: 6,286 beetle files exist (Paper 100) but no primal is named "beetle." the most numerous order in our animalia has no representative.
gap_5_beetle_gap.prescription: the beetles are not a single primal — they're a TRAIT expressed across all primals. like armor. every primal has beetle files.
gap_5_beetle_gap.biology_parallel: beetles ARE arthropoda. they're the largest order. in our system, the beetle trait is the elytra (Result<T,E>) which appears everywhere.

gap_6_archaea_tiny.what: only 23 archaea (17 crons + 5 WG + 1 tunnel). real archaea are 20% of microbial biomass.
gap_6_archaea_tiny.prescription: as infrastructure grows, archaea grow. more servers = more extremophiles. this is natural.
gap_6_archaea_tiny.biology_parallel: archaea were the LAST domain discovered (Woese, 1977). they're invisible until you look.

what_we_already_named_right.sporePrint: spore print = the pattern a mushroom cap leaves on paper. we named our publication system after FUNGAL REPRODUCTION and never said "fungus."
what_we_already_named_right.sweetGrass: Hierochloe odorata — a sacred grass. we put a PLANT in our cnidaria and nobody noticed.
what_we_already_named_right.rhizoCrypt: rhizo = root. the mycorrhizal network. we built the wood wide web and called it a jellyfish.
what_we_already_named_right.sourDough: sourdough = wild yeast (Saccharomyces) + bacteria (Lactobacillus). it's literally a FUNGI+BACTERIA symbiosis. we classified it as a mollusk.
what_we_already_named_right.gardens: we literally have a directory called "gardens" with 10 cultivated Rust projects. they're GARDENS.
what_we_already_named_right.springs: we have 12 "springs" with 4,753 Rust files. springs are where PLANTS grow.
what_we_already_named_right.loamSpine: loam = rich soil. the SPINE of the soil. where roots grow. where fungi live. it's the EARTH itself.
what_we_already_named_right.bonsai_bt: a BONSAI TREE in our gardens. we grew a bonsai and filed it under "Rust project."
what_we_already_named_right.lithoSpore: litho = rock, spore = fungal/plant reproduction. a LITHOPHYTE — a plant that grows on rocks. in our gardens.
what_we_already_named_right.banana_stage: Paper 100: banana = seed/spore stage. 2,153 files. the PLANT/FUNGAL beginning that everything grows from.

the_tree_diagram.note: ASCII tree of life for the membrane
the_tree_diagram.tree:
LIFE IN THE MEMBRANE
├── Domain BACTERIA (1,905 scripts)
│   ├── Python decomposers (1,014) — break down data
│   └── Shell bacteria (891) — one job, one effect
│
├── Domain ARCHAEA (23 extremophiles)
│   ├── cron jobs (17) — survive on timers
│   ├── WireGuard tunnels (5) — survive in encrypted channels
│   └── cloudflared (1) — survive on Cloudflare edge
│
└── Domain EUKARYA
    ├── Kingdom PROTISTA (115 files, 2 organisms)
    │   ├── footPrint (TypeScript) — the amoeba bridge
    │   └── tideGlass (TypeScript) — the diatom observer
    │
    ├── Kingdom FUNGI (829+ files) ⚠️ UNCLASSIFIED
    │   ├── sporePrint (514 md) — the FRUITING BODY
    │   ├── data layer (315 JSON) — the MYCELIUM
    │   ├── sourDough* — the YEAST (dual-kingdom: also animalia)
    │   └── rhizoCrypt* — the MYCORRHIZA (dual-kingdom: also animalia)
    │
    ├── Kingdom PLANTAE (5,600+ files) ⚠️ UNCLASSIFIED
    │   ├── HTML pages (660) — FLOWERING PLANTS (angiosperms)
    │   ├── JS families (177) — LEAVES (chloroplasts)
    │   ├── gardens/ (10 projects) — CULTIVATED PLANTS
    │   │   └── bonsai-bt, lithoSpore, cellMembrane...
    │   ├── springs/ (12 springs, 4,753 .rs) — WATER SOURCES
    │   │   └── hotSpring(1361), wetSpring(1136), neuralSpring(577)...
    │   └── sweetGrass* — SACRED GRASS (dual-kingdom: also animalia)
    │
    └── Kingdom ANIMALIA (45,829 classified files, 16 primals)
        ├── Phylum Vertebrata — toadStool, biomeOS
        ├── Phylum Arthropoda — nestGate, songBird, bearDog
        │   └── Order Coleoptera (beetles) — 6,286 armored files
        ├── Phylum Mollusca — petalTongue, sourDough*
        ├── Phylum Cnidaria — coralReef, squirrel, rhizoCrypt*, sweetGrass*, 
        │                      loamSpine, skunkBat, swarmVine, barraCuda
        └── Phylum Porifera — bingoCube
        
    * = dual-kingdom organism

gaps_stuffed.how: whats_missing cells get meat (volume), muscle (verb), or sinew (dual-kingdom / join). veil stays clothes. no sixth Vitruvian body.
